name: plugin.graphiti_memory
description: Temporal knowledge graph engine with bi-temporal edge invalidation and tri-brid search reranking

entrypoints.name: graphiti_add_episode
entrypoints.description: Ingest episodic interaction text into the temporal knowledge graph, extracting entities and facts

parameters.name: content
parameters.description: Raw interaction text, message payload, or document segment

parameters.name: group_id
parameters.description: Multi-tenant namespace or session identifier partition (default: 'default')

entrypoints.name: graphiti_search
entrypoints.description: Execute tri-brid search (dense vector, BM25 keyword, BFS graph proximity) with balanced merge reranking

parameters.name: query
parameters.description: Natural language search query or concept

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: Maximum number of ranked facts to return (default: 5)

parameters.name: include_invalidated
parameters.description: Set true for historical time-travel analysis of superseded facts (default: false)

entrypoints.name: graphiti_get_entity
entrypoints.description: Retrieve full entity node state, summaries, attributes, and incident relationships

parameters.name: name_or_uuid
parameters.description: Canonical entity name or UUID identifier

entrypoints.name: graphiti_invalidate_fact
entrypoints.description: Mark a fact relation edge as invalidated with a timestamped record to preserve historical truth

parameters.name: edge_uuid
parameters.description: UUID of the EntityEdge to invalidate

parameters.name: reason
parameters.description: Explanation for why the fact is no longer valid

entrypoints.name: graphiti_get_status
entrypoints.description: Inspect knowledge graph memory statistics and driver backend health
